home.heroSubtitle: Discover financial schemes, calculate your EMI, and find the nearest channel partners seamlessly. Your journey to financial independence starts here.
home.feature1Desc: Tell us your needs and eligibility, and our deterministic engine finds the perfect financial scheme for you instantly.
home.feature2Desc: Transparent EMI and repayment schedule calculation considering moratorium periods and subsidies.
home.feature3Desc: Find the nearest active Channel Partners (SCAs/PSBs) with available funds to process your application faster.
home.purposeSub: Government support programs can involve complex eligibility conditions, different application processes, financial terminology and multiple support channels. Scheme Saathi brings these pieces into one guided experience.
home.purposeDiscoverDesc: Find relevant opportunities instead of searching blindly through disconnected portals.
home.purposeUnderstandDesc: Break down complex eligibility rules, financial terms, and application requirements.
home.purposeActDesc: Move from discovery toward the appropriate application or find a trusted support channel.
home.capabilitiesTitle: Everything You Need to Navigate Support Opportunities
home.capabilitiesSub: A comprehensive suite of tools built for entrepreneurs.
home.discoveryTitle: Find Opportunities That Match Your Situation
home.discoveryDesc: Instead of searching through long lists of generic programs, start with what you are trying to accomplish. Our discovery engine filters opportunities based on your exact profile.
home.eligibilityDesc: Don't waste time filling out applications for programs you don't qualify for. We break down complex government notifications into clear, actionable checklists.
home.financialDesc: Government schemes often involve complex combinations of loans, subsidies, and margin money. Our financial tools help you estimate your exact commitments.
home.partnerDesc: Applying for a scheme is rarely a solo journey. Locate the correct nodal agencies, partner banks, incubators, and advisory services near you.
home.compareDesc: Evaluate multiple schemes side-by-side. Understand differences in subsidies, loan limits, and eligibility criteria so you can choose the optimal path for your business.
home.globalDesc: Entrepreneurial support is not limited to one country. Explore programs and opportunities across jurisdictions while understanding the eligibility requirements that may apply to citizens, residents and businesses.
home.testimonialSub: Hear from people who have used our platform to navigate government support.
home.newsletterDesc: Government programs change frequently. Get notified when new support opportunities relevant to entrepreneurs are announced.
